item.title: Alysa Liu retired at 16. Now, the figure skater is back — and going for gold on her own terms
item.description: By the time she retired from figure skating at the age of 16 in April 2022, Alysa Liu had in many ways already lived a full life.

item.title: American luger Sean Hollander is ready for the Olympics — and the 'Heated Rivalry' jokes
item.description: Shane Hollander, the fictional Canadian hockey player in “Heated Rivalry,” will not be competing at this year’s Milan Cortina Games

item.title: She's a contender to win Olympic gold. She says coming out is a big reason why.
item.description: Amber Glenn, a three-time U.S. champion figure skater, is a contender to medal in the Milan Cortina Winter Olympics, success she attributes in part to coming out as bisexual and pansexual.

item.title: Russian athletes to compete at the Milan Cortina Games, but not for Russia
item.description: For the second consecutive Olympic Games, no athletes will compete under the Russian flag

item.title: U.S. Olympic flag bearers are speedskater Erin Jackson and bobsledder Frank Del Duca
item.description: A speedskater from Florida who won Olympic gold in Beijing four years ago and a bobsledder from Maine making his second Olympic appearance will carry the U.S. flag at the opening ceremony of the 2026 Milan Cortina Winter Olympics in Italy, officials announced Tuesday

item.title: Rory Guilday's long road from chemotherapy to the Olympics
item.description: It was decision day for the best U.S. women’s hockey players, and Rory Guilday was cautiously confident despite being cut from the team a year earlier.

item.title: Team USA kicks off first competitions ahead of Opening Ceremony
item.description: With one day until the Opening Ceremony, competition is underway at Milan Cortina Olympics. Competition has already kicked off on the snow and ice at the Milan Cortina Olympics. The US women’s hockey team easily won their first game, while the first qualifying event was held in snowboarding. NBC News’ Stephanie Gosk reports.

item.title: This speedskater wants Olympic redemption after her dreams were shattered in 2022
item.description: For years, Kristen Santos-Griswold couldn’t even bring herself to watch the video of what happened.

item.title: Trump's objectives in Iran are unclear ahead of talks, sources say
item.description: WASHINGTON — Top Trump administration officials do not yet have clear guidance on what President Donald Trump would hope to accomplish with military action in Iran as U.S. and Iranian officials plan to meet Friday to try to avoid a war, according to two U.S. officials

item.title: New details in disappearance of Nancy Guthrie
item.description: New details in disappearance of Nancy Guthrie Investigators today revealed more information on the alleged ransom note, the timeline of when Nancy disappeared, and where the investigation stands. This, after Savannah and her siblings released an emotional plea to their mother’s potential captor in the hopes of getting her back. NBC News’ Liz Kreutz has the latest.
